title: Tin Moon, part by part
note: Written by hand from the code of the toy on the ttk page. Each step adds one part.

steps.say: Make a lander game. A canvas is space: dark, 296 by 176 pixels, with a few stars.
The canvas is space. The stars are small rectangles on a grid of 4 pixels, from a fixed seed, so each start looks the same.
steps.check:
update
expr {[winfo class .c] eq "Canvas" && [llength [.c find all]] == 24}
steps.name: canvas: space

steps.say: Use a slider as the throttle, at the right side.
A vertical ttk::scale from 100 at the top to 0 is the throttle. Its -variable throttle is the power of the engine.
steps.name: ttk::scale: the throttle

steps.say: Show the fuel under the playfield.
A ttk::progressbar with -variable fuel is the gauge. The game changes fuel, and the bar follows the variable.
steps.name: ttk::progressbar: the fuel

steps.say: Draw the ship, its flame, and a rough ground with a landing pad.
The proc sprite makes a ship of 2-pixel squares with one tag, so one move moves it all. The proc level makes the ground of columns and a gold pad, narrower on each level.
steps.check:
update
expr {[llength [.c find withtag ship]] > 20 && [llength [.c find withtag land]] == 37}
steps.name: canvas items: ship, flame, ground

steps.say: Make it fly. Gravity pulls, the throttle pushes and burns fuel, and a soft landing on the pad wins the level.
The proc tick is the loop: after 16 ms it runs again. It reads throttle, takes fuel, moves the ship, and checks the landing. Space starts, and Z and X fire the side jets.
steps.name: after 16 tick: the loop reads the throttle
